_comment: Override mnemonics that explicitly call out an asymmetric matchup — where atk→def differs from def→atk. Key = 'attacker>defender'. When present, these take precedence over data/type_mnemonics.json. Only the most counter-intuitive asymmetries get an entry here; the rest fall back to the base mnemonic and just get the ⚖️ tag computed from the chart. Attacker is still the subject of every sentence.
electric>ground: Electricity goes straight to ground and stops cold — but ground swings back 2× because the earth itself smothers current.
ground>electric: Ground smothers every current to zero — while electricity can't find a circuit to complete in the dirt.
dragon>fairy: Dragons can't touch fairies at all — but fairies slay dragons in every legend.
fairy>dragon: Fairies are the classic dragonslayer — while dragons can't even land a scratch in return.
psychic>dark: Psychic can't read a dark mind at all — meanwhile dark minds ambush psychics from the shadows.
dark>psychic: Dark preys on the open mind from ambush — while psychics can't read the guarded dark mind at all.
fighting>ghost: Fighting punches straight through ghosts — meanwhile ghosts can't harm the grounded fighter.
ghost>fighting: Ghosts simply don't affect the grounded fighter — meanwhile fighting's fists pass through ghosts entirely.
ground>flying: Ground attacks can't hit the airborne — but flyers still swoop in and crush rocks.
flying>ground: Flyers ignore ground attacks entirely — but rumble doesn't reach the sky either.
ice>dragon: Ice shatters dragon scales — meanwhile dragons don't care about a little chill.
ice>flying: Ice grounds birds with freezing wind — but flying gusts barely disturb ice.
ice>ground: Frost heaves shatter hard-packed earth — but ground rumble barely dents ice.
ice>grass: Ice withers every leaf — meanwhile grass can't even tickle ice.
fighting>normal: Fighting lands clean on ordinary bodies — while a casual punch can't match trained muscle.
fighting>steel: Trained strikes dent armor plate — but steel blades barely bruise a fighter.
water>ground: Water floods dry ground into mud — but mudslides can't really hurt water.
water>rock: Water carves rock over time — but a rockslide splashes harmlessly.
electric>water: Electricity ripples through every pool — but splashing water at a wire just conducts without damage.
bug>psychic: Bugs break concentration with skittering chaos — while psychic tricks don't really faze a bug.
bug>dark: Bugs exploit the shadows — but dark tricks don't bother a simple bug.
psychic>poison: Psychic force overrides toxins — but poison can't really grip a mind.
psychic>fighting: Mind tricks stop the muscle cold — meanwhile raw muscle fumbles against psychic shields.
flying>fighting: Flying strikes from above before fists connect — while ground-bound fists can't reach the sky.
rock>flying: Rocks clip birds out of the sky — but wings can't shake a mountain.
